name: r3-station
notes: Scenes R3 G1 STATION + TRAIN (research/sprint-0930/scenes-r3/PLAN.md, G1-NOTES.md). Runs right after variant-v2, so the beat numbers are variant-v2's own.

One background per line: 1 station-gate-r3 (ref 12, 4:30 overcast, board 4:30 -> OR) | 2 station-ads (ref 11, NAND駅, WATCHING YOU) | 3 station-ads-insert (ref 11 crop + IC gate, sharp) | 4 train-sun (ref 13, 4:40) | 5 train-rain (ref 14, 5:20 rain) | 6 platform-rain (ref 09/08/10, OR駅, her empty spot).

Each beat replaces its props so the old camera shots (station-gate alias, ots, closeup of train, train-door) are gone: no pans, no animation. Props carry forward in a scene, so beat 4 resets the cut that beat 3 set.

train-r4 (research/sprint-0930/train-r4/PLAN.md, NOTES.md): v2-train is now the 9-beat script. One face per beat via props.cut.face (cut.raise = her raised pose over a 3-line box, so the face stays in view) (art/nanda.js TRAIN_FACES + the Scene A faces): 0 heart-laugh | 1 nervous | 2 anya-smile | 3 ticked-off -> puff (two-step at 'They laugh.') | 4 very-angry | 5 content | 6 happy | 7 dazed-sleepy | 8 smug-gloating.

train-r4 stage B art: 1 station-gate-r3 + 3/4 station-ads = the crowd (Crowd.jsx: 2 silhouette layers, sun shafts, the two bumpers; props.bump laugh|named) and the platform machine (Vending.jsx PlatformVending; its top row = props.drink, set on every station beat by vary.bento) | 2 vending-insert (ref 09 close-up, she points at the drink) | 7 train-rain-sleepy (she lies on the dialogue bar, cut.frame off hides the standing sprite).
